cards.power: Narrative Sabotage. Dispels techno-scenic illusions in a 5-mile radius.

cards.power: Extracts 6 hours and 58 minutes of lifespan daily from 86% of global players.

cards.power: Infiltrates the user's pocket. Automatically uploads your soul to the Cloud.

cards.power: Triggers infinite scroll doom loop. Disables critical thinking.

cards.power: Forces submission posture. Cripples all melee attention.

cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro spectral. Subject: chihuahua nervously checking empty pocket, ghost notification floating nearby. Mood: anxious paranoia.

cards.power: Forces the player to check their screen every 4 seconds.

cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro search. Subject: magnifying glass inside phone scanning family photos before sending shadows to mothership. Mood: sanctioned intrusion.

cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro military consumer. Subject: army general handing branded lifestyle phone to smiling shopper. Mood: patriotic surveillance comedy.

cards.gradeReason: 'Raid without logging in' has heist energy but the card describes the action rather than performing it.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro heist. Subject: masked fox sneaking apps from Google vault without leaving footprints. Mood: elegant anonymous theft.

cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro pirate. Subject: pirate ship of banned app icons sailing past Silicon Valley watchtowers. Mood: defiant survival.

cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro retro. Subject: owl at desktop PC breathing deeply while phone withers in trash. Mood: dignified withdrawal.

cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro academic. Subject: raccoon in teacher robes transforming hunted rabbit into ninja system admin. Mood: empowering underground education.

cards.power: Cuts off the feed. Reduces baseline anxiety to zero.
cards.lore: Treat Taschenspion like a loaded weapon. Check it twice a day, then lock it in a drawer. You are not a slave to the notification bell.

cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro tactical. Subject: ninja locking phone in drawer with military precision, notification bell dying. Mood: disciplined liberation.

cards.power: Wins the game. Reclaims human freedom.
cards.lore: You must withdraw from the network of total surveillance while you still can. The seductive convenience of the observation economy has a high price: Freedom.
cards.gradeReason: Wins the game. That's the whole instruction. Embodiment is the entire point.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro triumph. Subject: rabbit leaping through TV screen into sunlit analog field, surveillance drones dissolving. Mood: joyful rebellion.

verdict: The Observation Underground ADD is a laser-focused surveillance satire expansion that earns its place. The structural arc — from surveillance infrastructure through physical health rot, algorithmic anxiety, corporate data-krakens, military origins, and finally counter-strike alternatives — is the real achievement here: it's not just cards, it's a complete epistemic journey. Named weakness: the technical cards (BLE Mesh, CO2-Budgeting) stay too deep in the spec sheet and resist embodiment. Named strength: the counter-culture section (Dumb-Phone, Removable Battery, Tactical Flight Mode, Escaping the Matrix) lands with genuine ritual energy. Table-ready: Yes.
blurb: Forty-eight cards exposing the full surveillance stack — from your pocket spy to the exit hatch. For the digitally awake, the analog curious, and everyone carrying their own prison warden.

coverQA.coverVisual: 4 — Strong 2x2 card layout on parchment background with FrizzleBob prominently featured top-left; illustrated characters are distinctive and polished.
coverQA.coverTitle: 5 — 'Welcome to the Kult, Sheeple!' is viral-grade trolling that immediately sets the satirical contract.
coverQA.coverVibeMatch: 5 — Cover tone matches deck contents perfectly: conspiratorial, funny, slightly unhinged in the best way.
coverQA.coverOriginality: 4 — Kayfabizarro visual language is consistent and recognizable; the cover-as-first-card-page is an efficient choice.
coverQA.coverViral: 5 — 'Sheeple' angle plus FrizzleBob anarchist rabbit energy is prime shareable content for tech-skeptic audiences.
coverQA.coverNote: Uncle FrizzleBob on the cover is the right call — the deck's narrator announces himself on page one and dares you to close the PDF. The 'Stay fluffy!' and 'KayfaBIZARRO!' sidebar stamps already teach the game's tonal register before you read a single card. This is how a cover should work.

notes: Deck is an ADD (addition/expansion) file — the base 'Observation Underground' deck likely exists separately. The 'Architects Daughter' font label appears on selected card spreads (pages 3, 5, 7, 8, 9, 12) as a deliberate design-system tag indicating voice register, not a rendering artifact. All 12 pages follow consistent 2x2 card grid layout with thematic spread titles acting as section headers. Sidebar stamps (BLÖDSINN!, What the FLUFF?!, HUMBUG!, KayfaBONGO!, KayfaBIZARRO!, CLASSIFIED!, INFESTED!, etc.) provide reactive flavor throughout. Deck was created 2026-05-29 per PDF metadata — fresh build.

quickWins: CO2-BUDGETING: reframe lore to embody the bureaucrat issuing the carbon denial, not the system itself
B.L.E. MESH NETWORK: replace IMEI spec detail with a single behavioral metaphor (e.g. 'your phone already reported this conversation')
niceToHave: Consider adding 1-2 more pure counter-culture G1 cards — threat:counter ratio is currently ~8:4, bumping counter-strike cards would balance the emotional arc
THE PRIVACY ACADEMY: remove Rob Braxman name-drop or add one-line context so uninitiated players can embody without googling

marketingText:
Kayfabizarro: OBSERVATION UNDERGROUND – Forty-Eight Cards Against the Pocket Warden (Free Cut & Play Comic Card Game)

The most loyal informant you own sleeps on your nightstand and charges off your own wall socket.

It wakes before you do. The microphone never fully clocks out, the radio keeps reporting your position to towers you will never see, and the battery is sealed in deep so you cannot starve the thing on command. You did not buy a phone. You adopted a warden, signed the lease inside a terms-of-service box, and thanked it for the nice camera.

Observation Underground is Social Story Wrestling aimed straight at the surveillance stack. Forty-eight cut-and-play cards that run the whole chain, from the spy in your pocket to the analog exit hatch, and you perform each link out loud while the table rules on whether the gadget gets away with it.

WHAT'S INSIDE?
- The Observation Underground Core Deck: 48 High-Res "Print, Cut & Play" Cards, featuring THE REMOVABLE BATTERY, the off-switch they quietly engineered out of your hands, TACTICAL FLIGHT MODE, the small ritual that buys you one honest pocket of silence, and DARPA'S TOY, the research project that grew up and moved into your jeans.
- The Freestyle Rules: the complete Anti-Rulebook. No complicated math, just storytelling, dice-driven chaos, and a roster of reactive stamps, BLÖDSINN!, CLASSIFIED!, INFESTED!, that the table slaps down the second a cover story gets suspiciously tidy.
- The Counter-Surveillance Engine: the roster runs the full stack in order, from the always-on device to the way back out, so by the last card you can name every link that watches you and the short list of moves that cut it.

THE "LIVING DECK" PASS (Free Updates)
Grab this and you are not buying a frozen PDF. You are filing onto the Dark Journalism beat. Every future expansion and freshly leaked variant in this cycle reaches you as a free update, no second checkout.

WHY "PAY WHAT YOU WANT"?
I draw these because a watcher you can name is a watcher you can finally switch off. Broke? Enter "0" and take it. Print it, cut it, run the stack at your own kitchen table. Want to support the craft? Every euro goes straight into the time I spend drawing the next cards and sharpening the mechanics.
Free to use, share, and adapt under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Share freely, attribute honestly, never resell.

Choose your reality. Become an Epistemic Outlaw.
"Convenience was never free. You just paid in a currency you never saw leave your account."
Stay fluffy. — Uncle FrizzleBob
